Set up OneNote

Unofficial Linux client. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

Your work or school account

OneNote signs you in through Microsoft, but many organisations hand off to their own server first. If that server is not recognised, your browser opens instead and the app never returns. Finding it now avoids that.

How do I find this myself?
  1. Use your work email, or just the part after the @. A school might be ac.uk or sch.uk; a company usually its own name.
  2. If you are not sure, sign in to Microsoft 365 in your browser. The address bar shows your organisation's domain once you are in.
  3. Or open Microsoft 365 in the app and let it fail. The address that opens in your browser is the sign-in server, for example sts.your-school.ac.uk. Copy that host into the box below.
Enter it manually

Hostname only, no https:// and no path. It is checked against the same rules that decide what may load in this window.
